metadata.source_note: The official January 2026 guide affirmatively states that South Dakota does not have a personal income tax. The guide separately identifies taxes that may apply to businesses. This intake supports the absence of natural-person personal income tax through the pre-credit tax stage. It does not certify a complete nonrefundable-credit, refundable-credit, or signed net-liability surface, and it does not cover business or entity taxes, payments, filing administration, local taxes, or nonresident allocation.
metadata.title: South Dakota January 2026 Sales and Use Tax Guide
